fields.System.Title: INT-502 — Locations with no capacity
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want a list of locations missing the data putaway needs, so
that the algorithm stops making suggestions nobody can follow.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the report, then it lists active locations with a null or zero max weight, max
  • volume, or pick sequence.
  • - Given the report, then it also flags pick locations with duplicate sequence numbers
  • and sequence gaps that suggest a route error.
  • - Given a location, then the report shows whether it currently holds stock.
  • - Given the report, then it runs weekly and its output reaches a person.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, masterdata |
| Tables | location |
| Risks | Null capacity breaking putaway ([doc 03 §7.4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)); wrong pick sequence ([doc 03 §4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
